youtube.title: Why Do We Have Eyebrows? 🤨 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Eyebrows help channel sweat and rainwater away from the eyes: the arched shape and the sideways direction of the hairs guide moisture to the sides of the face. They are also important for expressing emotion and for recognising faces.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
